apidocs.title: API & console
apidocs.intro: The API lets you control your proxies and your automation programmatically over HTTP. Every endpoint is documented below, and you can try them live from the console at the bottom of the page.
apidocs.auth.body: Every request authenticates with an API key in the Authorization header, prefixed with Bearer. Cookies are never used, so the API is immune to CSRF.
apidocs.auth.once: The key is shown only once, when you create it — store it somewhere safe.
apidocs.scopes.intro: Each key carries a limited set of permissions. Request only the ones you need (least privilege).
apidocs.scope.credentials_note: write third-party game credentials (elevated; they can never be read back)
apidocs.ratelimits.body: Requests are throttled per IP and per key. Endpoints that run an outbound network probe (create/edit/test a proxy, assign a proxy to an account, create an account or rotate credentials) carry an extra, much stricter limit.
apidocs.rl.per_ip_desc: shields the auth layer from a flood
apidocs.rl.per_key_desc: the overall cap for each authenticated key
apidocs.rl.strict_desc: only on the endpoints that run an outbound probe (they take several seconds)
apidocs.ratelimits.status: When a limit is exceeded the response is
apidocs.secrets.heading: Secrets are write-only
apidocs.secrets.proxy_url: the decrypted proxy URL or its user/password (only host, port and scheme come back)
apidocs.secrets.dosid: the session token (dosid) — only a boolean telling you whether one is on file
apidocs.secrets.internals: the automation's internal state (combat logic, reach, state machine)
apidocs.secrets.writeonly: Create/edit endpoints accept these values in the request body, but no response ever reflects them back.
apidocs.errors.body: Errors are a small JSON object with an error field carrying a stable code and no detail (so nothing leaks).
apidocs.err.unauthorized: key missing, invalid, revoked or expired
apidocs.err.scope: the key lacks the required permission
apidocs.err.not_found: the resource does not exist or isn't yours
apidocs.err.conflict: state conflict (e.g. deleting a proxy in use, or a license already bound)
apidocs.err.rate: you exceeded a rate limit; retry later
apidocs.ep.whoami: Returns the identity behind the key (user id, key name and permissions). Exposes no secret — ideal to verify a key works.
apidocs.ep.proxies_list: List the proxies you own (safe metadata only).
apidocs.ep.proxy_get: Return one proxy's metadata, including the accounts assigned to it.
apidocs.ep.proxy_create: Register a proxy. The URL (with any credentials) is write-only — it is never returned.
apidocs.ep.proxy_dup_note: If another user already registered the same proxy, the response carries a duplicateElsewhere field set to true (advisory; it never says who).
apidocs.ep.proxy_update: Update the label and/or URL. A new URL is validated and probed; an empty URL keeps the stored one.
apidocs.ep.proxy_update_note: Send at least a label or a URL.
apidocs.ep.proxy_delete: Delete a proxy you own. Refused while a running account depends on it; returns the labels of the stopped accounts that lost it.
apidocs.ep.proxy_test: Run the egress + latency diagnostics against the proxy and cache the result.
apidocs.ep.proxy_test_note: The exact fields depend on which probes answer. The response never includes the URL or credentials.
apidocs.ep.accounts_list: List your accounts with their live status (safe metadata only). If the key is restricted to some accounts, only those appear.
apidocs.ep.account_get: Return one account's metadata and status.
apidocs.ep.account_lifecycle: Start, stop, pause or resume an account's automation. Returns the resulting status.
apidocs.ep.account_patch: Assign a proxy or a license and update non-secret settings. Never touches credentials.
apidocs.ep.account_patch_note: A proxyId or licenseId of 0 clears the assignment; a positive id assigns it; omitting the field leaves it unchanged.
apidocs.ep.account_create: Create an account with its third-party game credentials. The password is write-only.
apidocs.ep.account_create_note: Requires the elevated accounts:credentials permission. The response returns safe metadata only.
apidocs.ep.account_credentials: Change an account's username and/or password. Write-only: the response never reflects them.
apidocs.console.title: Try it
apidocs.console.intro: Paste a key, pick an endpoint and fire a real request. It's the best way to learn the API.
apidocs.console.warn_body: The console calls the real API with your key: changes (create, edit, start, stop…) take effect. Start with read (GET) endpoints.
apidocs.console.key_hint: Kept only in this tab's memory — never stored or logged. Close the tab to discard it.
